import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Scanner;

def main():
    MOD = 998244353
    
    class FFT:
        maxk = 21
        maxn = (1 << maxk) + 1
        
        wR = [0.0] * maxn
        wI = [0.0] * maxn
        rR = [0.0] * maxn
        rI = [0.0] * maxn
        aR = [0.0] * maxn
        aI = [0.0] * maxn
        
        n = 0
        k = 0
        lastk = -1
        dp = [0] * maxn

        @staticmethod
        def fft(inv):
            if FFT.lastk != FFT.k:
                FFT.lastk = FFT.k
                FFT.dp[0] = 0
                for i in range(1, FFT.n):
                    if (i & (i - 1)) == 0:
                        g = -1
                    g = (i.bit_length() - 1) if (i & (i - 1)) == 0 else g
                    FFT.dp[i] = FFT.dp[i ^ (1 << g)] ^ (1 << (FFT.k - 1 - g))
                
                FFT.wR[1] = 1.0
                FFT.wI[1] = 0.0
                for t in range(FFT.k - 1):
                    a = 3.141592653589793 / FFT.n * (1 << (FFT.k - 1 - t))
                    curR = math.cos(a)
                    curI = math.sin(a)
                    p2 = 1 << t
                    p3 = p2 * 2
                    j = p2
                    k = j * 2
                    while j < p3:
                        FFT.wR[k] = FFT.wR[j]
                        FFT.wI[k] = FFT.wI[j]
                        FFT.wR[k + 1] = FFT.wR[j] * curR - FFT.wI[j] * curI
                        FFT.wI[k + 1] = FFT.wR[j] * curI + FFT.wI[j] * curR
                        j += 1
                        k += 2
            
            for i in range(FFT.n):
                d = FFT.dp[i]
                if i < d:
                    tmp = FFT.aR[i]
                    FFT.aR[i] = FFT.aR[d]
                    FFT.aR[d] = tmp
                    tmp = FFT.aI[i]
                    FFT.aI[i] = FFT.aI[d]
                    FFT.aI[d] = tmp
            
            if inv:
                for i in range(FFT.n):
                    FFT.aI[i] = -FFT.aI[i]
            
            len_val = 1
            while len_val < FFT.n:
                for i in range(0, FFT.n, len_val):
                    wit = len_val
                    j = i + len_val
                    it = 0
                    while it < len_val:
                        tmpR = FFT.aR[j] * FFT.wR[wit] - FFT.aI[j] * FFT.wI[wit]
                        tmpI = FFT.aR[j] * FFT.wI[wit] + FFT.aI[j] * FFT.wR[wit]
                        wit += 1
                        FFT.aR[j] = FFT.aR[i] - tmpR
                        FFT.aI[j] = FFT.aI[i] - tmpI
                        FFT.aR[i] += tmpR
                        FFT.aI[i] += tmpI
                        j += 1
                        it += 1
                len_val <<= 1

        @staticmethod
        def multiply(a, b):
            na = len(a)
            nb = len(b)
            FFT.k = 0
            FFT.n = 1
            while FFT.n < na + nb - 1:
                FFT.n <<= 1
                FFT.k += 1
            
            for i in range(FFT.n):
                FFT.aR[i] = a[i] if i < na else 0
                FFT.aI[i] = b[i] if i < nb else 0
            
            FFT.fft(False)
            FFT.aR[FFT.n] = FFT.aR[0]
            FFT.aI[FFT.n] = FFT.aI[0]
            q = -1.0 / FFT.n / 4.0
            
            for i in range(FFT.n - i + 1):
                tmpR = FFT.aR[i] * FFT.aR[i] - FFT.aI[i] * FFT.aI[i]
                tmpI = FFT.aR[i] * FFT.aI[i] * 2
                tmpR -= FFT.aR[FFT.n - i] * FFT.aR[FFT.n - i] - FFT.aI[FFT.n - i] * FFT.aI[FFT.n - i]
                tmpI -= FFT.aR[FFT.n - i] * FFT.aI[FFT.n - i] * -2
                FFT.aR[i] = -tmpI * q
                FFT.aI[i] = tmpR * q
                FFT.aR[FFT.n - i] = FFT.aR[i]
                FFT.aI[FFT.n - i] = -FFT.aI[i]
            
            FFT.fft(True)
            result_len = na + nb - 1
            ans = [0] * result_len
            for i in range(result_len):
                ans[i] = round(FFT.aR[i]) % MOD
            return ans

        @staticmethod
        def multiplyPrecise(a, b):
            k_val = int(math.sqrt(MOD))
            a1 = [0] * len(a)
            a2 = [0] * len(a)
            b1 = [0] * len(b)
            b2 = [0] * len(b)
            
            for i in range(len(a)):
                a1[i] = a[i] % k_val
                a2[i] = a[i] // k_val
            
            for i in range(len(b)):
                b1[i] = b[i] % k_val
                b2[i] = b[i] // k_val
            
            r11 = FFT.multiply(a1, b1)
            r12 = FFT.multiply(a1, b2)
            r21 = FFT.multiply(a2, b1)
            r22 = FFT.multiply(a2, b2)
            
            res = [0] * len(r11)
            for i in range(len(res)):
                res[i] = (k_val * k_val * r22[i] + k_val * (r12[i] + r21[i]) + r11[i]) % MOD
            return res
    
    import math
    
    in_stream = sys.stdin
    n = int(in_stream.readline().strip())
    k = int(in_stream.readline().strip())
    base = [0] * 10

        idx = int(in_stream.readline().strip())
        base[idx] = 1
    
    def expo(orig, pow_val):
        if pow_val == 1:
            return orig
        if (pow_val & 1) != 0:
            return FFT.multiplyPrecise(orig, expo(orig, pow_val - 1))
        tmp = expo(orig, pow_val >> 1)
        return FFT.multiplyPrecise(tmp, tmp)
    
    res = expo(base, n >> 1)
    tot = 0
    for e in res:
        tot = (tot + (e * e) % MOD) % MOD
    
    print(tot)

    import sys
    main()
